messages:
maria: FYI I opened PR 6289 to add storage examples for Private, but it includes a sample config with a placeholder that looks like a credential. Need legal + security review before we merge. Also the docs preview CI failed on a broken link.

sam: thanks for the heads up. do you have the CI preview link? I can ping sec for an initial check. :eyes:

maria: https://ci.internal/docs-preview/6289 - error shows on /private/deploy.md line ~92 — the S3 snippet.

jeff: tagging in legal — @jeff (legal) here, I can do the redaction review. if it's just placeholder creds we can replace with a sanitized example and a note about secrets.

alex: quick note: the snippet currently has `access_key = "AKIA..."` — please remove any literal-like tokens. proposed replacement:```ini
[s3]
endpoint = "s3.example.com"
bucket = "redwood-examples"
# do not store real credentials in repo; use KMS or env vars
```

nina: +1 on removal. can we also add a short explainer about KMS/HSM usage for Private so customers know best practices?

maria: good call. I'll draft a brief paragraph and push an update to the PR.

docs-ci-bot: docs preview build failed for PR 6289 — link-checker: broken link at /private/deploy.md#s3-setup -> http://old.example.com/docs/onprem (404)

sam: looks like an old anchor. I'll search the docs site and propose the correct URL in the same PR.

jeff: Legal checklist: 1) confirm no PII or secrets committed, 2) ensure wording around compliance is accurate, 3) approve redacted example. I can complete this review today if you push the sanitized snippet.

maria: will push in ~30m. tagging @security-bot for a quick threat-scan on config exposition.

security-bot: Security scan request received for PR 6289. Pending manual review by sec team. Estimated turnaround 4 hrs.

alex: for merge timing: we usually wait for both CI green and legal signoff. If legal is quick and security marks low risk, can we merge in the same day? team: agree? :+1: / :-1:

nina: +1 from docs side, but prefer to wait for CI link-check and security low risk.

sam: pinging sec on Slack channel now.

jeff: once legal signs off I'll add a one-line approval in the PR.

maria: pushed sanitized snippet and updated the anchor to the new onprem guide. CI rebuild queued.

docs-ci-bot: docs preview build started for PR 6289.

security-bot: Manual review complete — low risk flag. Please ensure the docs don't instruct storing credentials in plaintext (note added).

jeff: legal signoff: confirmed. no issues with wording after redaction.

maria: awesome — CI passed. merging now. thanks everyone for quick turnaround :tada:

sam: great! reminder for post-merge: open a short follow-up to add a KMS example snippet in a later PR (tracking: DOCS-142).

alex: noted, i'll add DOCS-142 to the backlog.

maria: closing loop here — PR merged at 2026-03-20T14:22:30Z. thanks all.

jeff: thanks, team.
